caption: The drawing depicts a transparent glass stein with a lid and a handle. The stein is cylindrical, slightly tapering towards the base, and features evenly spaced horizontal ridges around its body and base. The lid is domed with a decorative finial shaped like a spiral cone, and fits closely over the top of the stein. The handle is attached to the upper and lower parts of the stein’s side, curving outward and downward before looping back towards the body, ending in a small coil at the base. The glass is rendered in light blue and gray tones, with highlights and shading suggesting transparency and shine. The drawing is framed by a thin, hand-drawn rectangular border, and the artist's name, P. L. Johnson, is inscribed in small letters in the bottom right corner. The background is plain and light-colored.
title: Covered Mug
